reason: The README describes an MCP server for orchestrating Harness agents and tools through synchronous or queued coding tasks, including shell and filesystem access; its documented unauthenticated remote code execution capability warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 将外部客户端连接到 Harness 智能体，以委派、排队并获取可执行的编码任务结果。
summaries.en: Connects external MCP clients to Harness agents so they can delegate, queue, and retrieve executable coding tasks.

capabilities: Bridges external MCP clients to Harness agents and tools
Executes synchronous and asynchronous coding tasks
Can invoke Harness tools including bash, filesystem, todo, and web capabilities
Returns structured task results including tool calls, changes, and verification
